// 14 - Temperance (the Resonant). Goal: cause reactions; 3 / 6 / 15 in ARCANA_Aspect_Common.txt (spec 9).
//   Tier I Resonance and the feelings +2 of Tier II live in Stats. Here: the count, the free Surge of Tier II Harmony
//   and the Tier III wave. GENERATED by gen_emotion_alchemy.pl -- do not edit by hand.
//REGION Tables
PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init()
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_AwakeningStatus(_S)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_AwakeningStatus(_S);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init()
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SurgeRoot(_R, _E)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SurgeRoot(_R, _E);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init()
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Feeling(_F)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Feeling(_F);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init()

DB_ARCANA_Resonant_AwakeningStatus("FEELING_AGGRESSIVENESS");

IF
SavegameLoaded()
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init();
//END_REGION

//REGION Goal: every feeling, intense emotion and Catharsis caused (The Two Cups: each one)
IF
StatusApplied(_Target, _Status, (CHARACTER)_Resonant, _)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_AwakeningStatus(_Status)
AND
HasPassive(_Resonant, "Arcana_Passive_Aspect_Temperance_Awakening", 1)
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Aspect_Step(_Resonant, "TEMPERANCE");
//END_REGION

//REGION Tier II: Harmony -- once per turn a Weave Surge costs no action (R40; the Fool's Zephyr Strike pattern)
PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Aspect_OnTier((CHARACTER)_Resonant, (STRING)_Aspect, (INTEGER)_Tier)
AND
_Aspect == "TEMPERANCE"
AND
_Tier == 2
THEN
ApplyStatus(_Resonant, "RESONANT_SURGE_FREE", 6.0, 1, _Resonant);
ApplyStatus(_Resonant, "RESONANT_TIER2", -1.0, 1, _Resonant);

// DB_ARCANA_AspectReached keeps no Aspect: the passive keeps Harmony to the Resonant
IF
TurnStarted((CHARACTER)_Resonant)
AND
DB_ARCANA_AspectReached(_Resonant, 2)
AND
HasPassive(_Resonant, "Arcana_Passive_Aspect_Temperance_II", 1)
THEN
ApplyStatus(_Resonant, "RESONANT_SURGE_FREE", 6.0, 1, _Resonant);

IF
CastedSpell((CHARACTER)_Resonant, _Spell, _, _, _)
AND
DB_ARCANA_CardFamily(_Spell, _Root)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SurgeRoot(_Root, _)
AND
HasActiveStatus(_Resonant, "RESONANT_SURGE_FREE", 1)
THEN
RemoveStatus(_Resonant, "RESONANT_SURGE_FREE", _Resonant);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Aspect_Reset((CHARACTER)_Char)
THEN
RemoveStatus(_Char, "RESONANT_SURGE_FREE", _Char);
RemoveStatus(_Char, "RESONANT_TIER2", _Char);
//END_REGION

//REGION Tier III: the dam breaks -- waking it fills the Overload meter (R56)
PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Aspect_OnTier((CHARACTER)_Resonant, (STRING)_Aspect, (INTEGER)_Tier)
AND
_Aspect == "TEMPERANCE"
AND
_Tier == 3
AND
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_OverloadFull(_Resonant)
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Overload_Fill(_Resonant);
//END_REGION
EXITSECTION

ENDEXITSECTION
